## Problem

A clear description of the problem or limitation this feature would address.
e.g. "I find it frustrating when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar implementations, or any other context that helps illustrate the request.
